source.section: Front matter — Context

claims.claim_text:
**Context**: Persistent low-outlier in the 55-map image generalisation
heterogeneity analysis.

values.quantity: map count, 55-map image-generalisation heterogeneity analysis

claims.notes: [BATCH NOTE b080] Scope decisions for this batch: map sheet names (K-35-075-1/-2/-3/-4, K-35-077-2) and the candidate identifiers in the two confidence tables (5560, 5601, 5556, 5616) are names/identifiers, out of C4 scope per instrument rule 5 — the vote counts, probabilities and distances reported against those identifiers ARE extracted. Numbered list markers in § Recommendation for the paper (1., 2., 3., 4.) and markdown table alignment rows are not claims. Buffer radii appearing only to label which row/column a metric belongs to ("Hungarian match @ 50 m", "Mean F1 @ 50 m", "SD @ 50 m", "Min F1 @ 50 m") are treated as row identifiers, not claims, following the b078 precedent; radii asserted as the grid actually run (line 5's 20/30/40/50 m; line 42's 50 m matching buffer) ARE extracted. Anchor notes for the batch: the document reports per-map quantities that no committed artefact records at per-map granularity beyond results/55maps-image-generalisation/per_map_metrics.csv (columns dataset, map_name, buffer_m, n_tiles, n_refs, n_dets, precision, recall, f1) — per-map TP/FP/FN, match distances, and the n=54 (map-excluded) distribution all require recomputation and are marked recompute-script. per_map_metrics.csv filters of the form $[?(@.map_name=='K-35-075-3')].f1 match the map's four buffer rows, whose values are identical for every column quoted here (constant-collapse, v1.2 amendment 7). The tile manifest named by the run (inputs/tiles_384_55maps/full_evaluation_manifest.json per outputs/55maps-image-generalisation/launch_manifest.json $.resolved_config.proposer.manifest) is not present in the working tree, so the "tiles in manifest" count anchors to per_map_metrics.csv instead.
